posts.title: Fable 5 vs. GPT-5.6 Sol on an NP-Hard Problem: Does /goal Help?
posts.description: I gave Claude Fable 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol the same unpublished NP-hard optimization problem, with and without their native /goal mode. Fable 5 is a beast; /goal is not a game changer.
